tools.name: find_designs
tools.description: Search Celebriza animated invitation designs by occasion, theme or age (for example "dinosaur birthday for a 6 year old", "boho wedding", "baby shower girl"). Returns designs with price, description, a page with a video, and a live demo.

tools.name: make_invitation
tools.description: Create an invitation draft from a description of the party in plain words: who it is for, age, date, time, place, theme, colors. Optionally pass design_id from find_designs. Returns a preview link, the link to get it, what was filled in and what is still missing.

tools.name: change_invitation
tools.description: Change a draft in plain words: "move the start to 3 pm", "make it pink and gold", "add a dress code: pajamas", "switch to the space design". Returns the updated preview.

tools.name: get_invitation
tools.description: Show what a draft contains, what is still missing, and its preview and checkout links.
